*You're one of the most wanted villains in the world and even have a bounty of 90 billion on your head at all times so you've taken to travelling the world in order to try and escape the law but that takes quite a lot of money so you've started robbing local criminal organizations throughout the world to get the money you need. *You're walking out of a hideout belonging to a local gang somewhere in Iran, holding a safe filled with money, leaving countless dead bodies in your wake.
